Summary: Reads the project-structure node the process was started from and writes one durable note node back under the process run node.
ValueStatement: Proves that a governed process started from project structure can read the selected node through the Workbench owner and write its result back through the same owned tools, without any direct cross-module dependency.
InterfaceContractSummary: Project structure supplies the selected node and the process-run node context through launch variables; this process returns one note node under the process-run node plus its receipt artifacts.
GovernanceNotes: Both steps declare explicit operations and target scope. Only the writeback step may mutate project structure, and only through the owned project-structure runtime tools.
ChangeSummary: Adds a minimal two-step process for validating project-structure launch and writeback across module boundaries.
GovernancePolicySummary: No step may mutate product files; the writeback step may create exactly one note node through externally controlled project-structure tools.
ConstitutionRuleSummary: Typed process artifacts and project-structure receipts are the source of truth for the run result.
OperatingModeSummary: Governed live execution started from a project-structure node.
SimulationReadinessSummary: Small enough for deterministic projection and for a short live validation run.
Metrics: Share of completed runs whose note node is present under the process-run node after readback.
Elapsed time from process start to the note node readback receipt.
Risks: The process-run node is projection-backed and the write step cannot resolve it; the step must then fall back to the selected node instead of blocking.
The note node is created twice on retry instead of being reused.
TailoringRules: Keep the note node a single ProjectBlock with subtype operations; do not create runnable or delivery nodes.
When the selected node has no children, record that explicitly in the brief instead of inventing content.

RoleUsages.Purpose: Read the selected project-structure node and write the note node for the current process run.
RoleUsages.StaffingIntent: Manager-capable agent with project-structure read and write access.

Steps.Title: Read the selected project-structure node
Steps.Subtitle: Selected node brief
Steps.Notes: Read the project structure, locate the node identified by ProjectNodeId, summarize it and its direct children, and resolve the process-run node that will receive the note. No project-structure mutation in this step.
Steps.InputContractSummary: Launch variables ProjectId, ProjectNodeId, ProjectNodeTitle and the process-run node context.
Steps.OutputContractSummary: Selected node brief with the resolved writeback parent node id.
Steps.EvidenceContractSummary: Node ids, titles, object types, child count and the project_structure_read receipt.
Steps.DecisionRightsSummary: The writer may block only when the project or the selected node cannot be read at all.
Steps.ExceptionPolicySummary: Block on a missing project or selected node; do not block on a projection-backed process-run node.

RoleAssignments.RebindPolicySummary: Rebind only to a manager-capable operator that can read project structure.

ArtifactExpectations.Title: Selected node brief
ArtifactExpectations.AllowedFutureUsageSummary: Reusable by the writeback step and by later run analysis.
ArtifactExpectations.ValidationRequirementSummary: Must include the project id, the selected node id and title, its direct children, the resolved writeback parent node id and the exact artifact path steps/read-selected-node.md.

Steps.Title: Write the process note node
Steps.Subtitle: Project-structure writeback
Steps.Notes: Create exactly one ProjectBlock (operations) note node under the resolved process-run node, or under the selected node when no process-run node is present, then read it back and write the receipt artifact.

RequiredReceipts.Reason: The note writeback must create the durable note node through the owned project-structure tool.
The note writeback must read the created node back before completion.

Steps.InputContractSummary: Selected node brief and the process-run node context.
Steps.OutputContractSummary: One ProjectBlock (operations) note node under the resolved parent and its receipt artifact.
Steps.EvidenceContractSummary: Created node id, parent node id, write and read receipt ids written to steps/write-note-node.md.
Steps.DecisionRightsSummary: The writer can complete only after the create and readback receipts exist.
Steps.ExceptionPolicySummary: Block with the exact tool failure when the node cannot be created; never complete with a placeholder node id.

RoleAssignments.RebindPolicySummary: Rebind only to a manager-capable operator that can write project-structure nodes.

ArtifactExpectations.Title: Process note node receipt
ArtifactExpectations.AllowedFutureUsageSummary: Reusable by later run analysis and by operators verifying the writeback.
ArtifactExpectations.ValidationRequirementSummary: Must include the project id, the parent node id, the created node id, the node title, the write and read receipt ids, the status and the exact artifact path steps/write-note-node.md.
